Feature 1 · study

Denver Top 5

One public, editable set of five Denver places under the bio, all equal, each with a short reason, shareable as a Story and a web page.

Why we think it works

  • Letterboxd stops at four favorites on purpose: the limit is what makes a pick mean something.The Spinoff, Apr 2025
  • An easy first assignment for ambassadors, and a personal intro for every Denver user.Olivia’s proposal
  • Half built: sign-up already fills “My top {City} recs” with 3 places.Benable code today

How other apps do it

What we take from them

  1. Keep the number small and fixed, and put the row at the top of the profile (Letterboxd 4, StoryGraph 5).
  2. Pair the picks with words: a reason per pick (Rec League) and one line that reads the person (StoryGraph).
  3. Design the Top 5 as a card people can post (Wrapped), not only a profile section.
